status_meanings.vision_only: Specified, no verified implementation. Also used for normative charter and process sections that are not capabilities.
status_meanings.implemented_unverified: Code exists but no executed acceptance evidence was found at this revision.
status_meanings.prototype_verified: Runs controlled fixtures and tests in this repository; insufficient production proof.
status_meanings.implemented_verified: Exercised by repository tests against the stated acceptance cases at this revision.
status_meanings.production_eligible: Passed security, correctness, rights, performance and operating gates for a named scope. Not claimed for any requirement.
status_meanings.deprecated_or_invalidated: Superseded, disabled or failed a required contract.

requirements.section_title: Mission, positioning, and the standard of success
requirements.requirement: Provide the most capable open, locally runnable, programmable financial research environment, with a free core whose mathematics, methods and interfaces are not artificially paywalled.
requirements.implementation_evidence: README.md states the open-core position.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: A standing goal, not a testable capability; conformance is measured through Sections 5-61.

requirements.section_title: Product model: Eight integrated systems, one experience
requirements.requirement: Keep the eight original systems as one product on one evidence substrate rather than eight separate tools.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Six of the eight systems have running code and tests.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Atlas Intelligence and OSINT exist only as partial or absent systems.

requirements.section_title: Interface: almost limitless depth with minimal visible clutter
requirements.requirement: Restrict principal navigation to Explore, Studio, Lab and Monitor while exposing depth progressively.
requirements.implementation_evidence: The React terminal exposes the four root spaces with linked workspaces.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Studio, Lab and Monitor are thin; depth exists mainly for the terminal surface.

requirements.section_title: Replaceability and competition
requirements.requirement: Benchmark against professional terminals on capability and openness instead of copying them, and publish comparative evidence.
requirements.implementation_evidence: README.md documents positioning.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No independent competitive benchmark has been executed.

requirements.section_title: Architecture: the unified financial computing substrate
requirements.requirement: One adaptive-workspace substrate beneath the four spaces, with universal research objects, a compiler and one evidence kernel.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Identity, evidence kernel, compiler subset and SQLite storage exist and are tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Adaptive workspace and cross-surface object layer are partial.

requirements.section_title: Universal Research Object System (UROS)
requirements.requirement: Give every research asset a stable identity, type, version, lineage, permissions, time semantics and interface contract.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Versioned research objects with manifests and lineage exist for research and application paths.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: The full object-family catalogue (models, apps, portfolios, memos) is not implemented.

requirements.section_title: Data Fabric, Temporal Evidence Kernel, and source quality
requirements.requirement: Preserve the point-in-time evidence kernel and entity master with immutable records, availability semantics and source quality.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Reference database holds 26,440 evidence records; differential Python/SQL selection test passes.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Cross-source quality scoring is partial (Section 54).

requirements.section_title: Financial-Economic Ontology and entity graph
requirements.requirement: Distinguish Event, Outcome, Contract, ResolutionRule and Forecast, and never infer payoff equivalence from titles.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Issuer/security/listing/ticker identity with ambiguity refusal is implemented and tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Event, contract and forecast objects exist only as written contracts.

requirements.section_title: Data Rights Engine and sustainable open-source economics
requirements.requirement: Require a rights manifest for every dataset and artefact, and fail closed when redistribution is unknown or restricted.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Rights violations are refused by tests; restricted sources are labelled as restricted.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Rights-aware query planning across all feeds is partial.

requirements.section_title: Financial-Economic Compiler: the central original engineering asset
requirements.requirement: Compile typed financial equations, model graphs and scenarios into well-typed, evidence-aware plans with an IR.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Allowlisted operators, versioned graphs and refusal on contract mismatch are tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Parsing frontends, dependency planning and optimisation passes are partial.

requirements.section_title: Universal Execution Runtime and storage/compute architecture
requirements.requirement: Coordinate compatible compute engines while holding identity, job, provenance and artefact contracts constant.
requirements.implementation_evidence: SQLite/NumPy execution with recorded jobs exists.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No multi-engine scheduler, job queue or distributed execution.

requirements.section_title: Model Forge: unrestricted model creativity with enforced contracts
requirements.requirement: Support configure, compose, code and invent authoring paths with enforced typing and reproducibility.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Registered models and versioned graphs execute with declared coverage.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Visual authoring and an invention sandbox are absent.

requirements.section_title: Quant Lab, Alpha Foundry, and historical strategy simulation
requirements.requirement: Provide three simulation fidelities with mandatory timing, cost and survivorship disclosures.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Walk-forward experiments with leakage guards and audit records are tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Full backtest accounting (cash, positions, costs) is not implemented.

requirements.section_title: Institutional valuation, fixed income, derivatives, and portfolio risk
requirements.requirement: Deliver company models, fixed income, derivatives and portfolio risk to an institutional standard.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Bank residual income v2/v3 pass independent audits 29/29 and 16/16; DCF component checks pass.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Fixed income, derivatives and portfolio risk are unimplemented.

requirements.section_title: Atlas Intelligence: a real brain, not a mandatory chatbot
requirements.requirement: Provide optional language reasoning, statistical and neural learning, experiment planning and user context as separate services.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Model selection, calibration and audit records run offline.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Research planner, meta-learning and contextual services are absent; no LLM integration.

requirements.section_title: Global OSINT, news intelligence, and the Economic Reality Engine
requirements.requirement: Answer financial questions about real economic systems from legally usable sources, separating observed from inferred claims.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Only the Phase 7 energy/weather case study exists as a thin economic slice.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No OSINT ingestion, entity linking or claim labelling.

requirements.section_title: Research Operating System, Time Capsule, and Sentinel
requirements.requirement: Make each investigation a durable versioned project with hypotheses, evidence, methods and a replayable time capsule.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Information cutoffs, as-of selection and observation replay are implemented and tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Project lifecycle objects, Sentinel monitoring and Time Capsule export are partial.

requirements.section_title: Financial Application Compiler and plugin ecosystem
requirements.requirement: Compile typed application specifications into interfaces that reuse the same objects, evidence and permissions.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Declarative packages build, install, execute, fork and reproduce from a clean install.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: The Intent-to-Workspace frontend and a third-party plugin sandbox are absent.

requirements.section_title: API, SDK, scripting, and extension contracts
requirements.requirement: Expose a documented stable API for discovery, evidence, market and fundamental data, metrics, models and applications.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Typed FastAPI surface with stable operation ids, error envelopes and a saved OpenAPI baseline.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No published SDK, scripting bridge or extension packaging.

requirements.section_title: Security, privacy, safety, and operational governance
requirements.requirement: Enforce local-first operation, bounded request bodies and compressed responses, and explicit authorisation for connected actions.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Body limits, archive bounds and zip-bomb defences are tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No multi-tenant isolation, audit log or secrets management; operation remains loopback-only.

requirements.section_title: Stack evolution and implementation discipline
requirements.requirement: Treat prior phase reports as agent-reported until independently audited and keep one canonical architecture.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Phase acceptance documents record verification limits; dependency contract tests pass.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No open gap recorded.

requirements.section_title: Institutional Capability Benchmark (ICB)
requirements.requirement: Measure institutional claims in a public ICB suite with declared data rights, hardware and independent baselines.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Repository benchmarks and audits exist and are reproducible for their declared scope.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Most ICB suites have never been executed; see artifacts/icb_registry.json.

requirements.section_title: Development roadmap, priorities, and release gates
requirements.requirement: Stage the roadmap by dependency order with explicit release gates rather than calendar promises.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Phase 9.2.x acceptance documents record gates and blockers.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No specification-aligned roadmap existed before this checkpoint.

requirements.section_title: Architecture decision record and contribution governance
requirements.requirement: Require an ADR covering problem, alternatives, licensing, correctness, benchmark, decision and reversibility.
requirements.implementation_evidence: ADRs 0001-0003 exist for storage, identity and analytics.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No formal review or maintainer process.

requirements.section_title: Strategic risks and mitigation
requirements.requirement: Maintain a risk register (licensed data, dependency fragility, over-claiming) with mitigations.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Risk themes appear in distribution and beta documentation.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No consolidated, maintained risk register.

requirements.section_title: Canonical end-to-end research demonstrations
requirements.requirement: Demonstrate a fundamental underwrite end to end: filings, statements, assumptions, scenarios, provenance and a saved thesis.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Valuation and provenance steps run against SEC fixtures and are browser-tested for desktop.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Evidence reconciliation and narrative retrieval in Demonstration A are missing.

requirements.section_title: Research source and software inventory
requirements.requirement: Treat candidate repositories as evaluation candidates until licence, maintenance and security are verified.
requirements.implementation_evidence: A prose dependency evaluation document exists.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No machine-checked licence registry (Section 58).

requirements.section_title: Instructions for all future Atlas engineering agents
requirements.requirement: Read the specification and inspect the working tree before planning, and never fabricate implementation status.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Status vocabulary and evidence discipline applied here.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No open gap recorded.

requirements.section_title: Expansion decision and domain boundaries
requirements.requirement: Remain financial-first while making the substrate event-aware, probabilistic and decision-capable.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Only the specification defines this boundary.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No event-market capability exists.

requirements.section_title: Universal Event and Probability Engine
requirements.requirement: Provide reusable probability machinery with domain-specific evidence, calibration and settlement semantics.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No event, contract or settlement implementation.

requirements.section_title: Causal, decision, and opportunity intelligence
requirements.requirement: Distinguish observed relations, mechanism hypotheses and identified causal claims with estimands and null results.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Design document only.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No causal estimation code.

requirements.section_title: Domain packs, implementation gates, and event benchmarks
requirements.requirement: Package additional domains as optional packs on the shared substrate with their own gates and ICB-11..18.
requirements.implementation_evidence: A domain pack ships, installs and executes on the unchanged substrate.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Event-domain packs and ICB-11..18 are not implemented.

requirements.section_title: Atlas Real Estate Investment Intelligence
requirements.requirement: Underwrite property, lease and debt cash flows with evidence-backed assumptions, separating facts from model outputs.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Specification only.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No real estate ontology, lease model or geographic joins.

requirements.section_title: Platform constitution: the universal financial operating system
requirements.requirement: Serve novice and specialist users with one adaptive system rather than separate products.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Positioning only.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No conformance mechanism defined.

requirements.section_title: Users, complete jobs and adoption-critical workflows
requirements.requirement: Deliver complete role-based jobs (investor, analyst, quant, banker, advisor) with finished deliverables.
requirements.implementation_evidence: A role matrix and beta plan exist.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No role-complete workflow has been demonstrated end to end.

requirements.section_title: Universal investment model library and coverage contracts
requirements.requirement: Maintain a registry of models, strategies and indicators with kind, coverage, provenance and status.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Registered models execute with declared coverage; DCF and bank residual income are audited.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: The catalogue covers a small fraction of the specified model families.

requirements.section_title: Model composition, invention and computational research
requirements.requirement: Make every compatible model a node in a nested, versioned, callable graph with typed contracts.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Nested versioned graphs execute with schema checks and refusal on mismatch.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Tournament, invention sandbox and model search are absent.

requirements.section_title: Global financial terminal and market intelligence
requirements.requirement: Provide instrument-aware search, charting, screening and comparison with correct time, source and rights status.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Canonical series contract with provider identity, revisions, rights and a bounded overview projection.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Only listed equities with daily bars are covered; no funds, FX, options or live feeds.

requirements.section_title: Equity, fundamental, accounting and research desk
requirements.requirement: Create a financial statement graph with restatements, segments, leases and derived metrics carrying evidence ids.
requirements.implementation_evidence: SEC XBRL statements, restatement handling and derived metrics with provenance are tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Segments, leases and accounting-policy notes are absent.

requirements.section_title: Quantitative trading, strategy science and execution research
requirements.requirement: Support strategy families with point-in-time validation, cost-aware backtesting and execution research.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Walk-forward experiments with as-of data and audit are tested.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No execution simulation, transaction-cost model or broker integration.

requirements.section_title: Institutional portfolio management, risk and operations
requirements.requirement: Provide positions, cash, orders, cost basis, FX, benchmarks and risk with correct accounting.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No position, order or portfolio accounting implementation.

requirements.section_title: Investment banking and transaction intelligence
requirements.requirement: Deliver comps, precedents, three-statement forecasts, debt schedules and merger consequences with provenance.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No banking workflow beyond the bank valuation model.

requirements.section_title: Venture capital, private equity, private credit and fund intelligence
requirements.requirement: Model private company identity, cap tables, financing events and fund economics.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No private-market data model or fund mathematics.

requirements.section_title: Personal finance, wealth and consumer decision support
requirements.requirement: Help a user understand flows, holdings and risks and how choices change outcomes without unsupported guarantees.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No accounts, planning or consent model.

requirements.section_title: Adaptive experience, human factors and professional workflow design
requirements.requirement: Keep four permanent root spaces and adapt depth to skill without changing the mathematics.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Navigation exists; adaptivity does not.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No progressive disclosure or accessibility certification.

requirements.section_title: Quant Stack compatibility and migration contract
requirements.requirement: Reconstruct the user's existing Quant Stack workflows and migrate them with declared differences.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No importer, compatibility fixture or parity report.

requirements.section_title: Enterprise, institutions, connectivity and deliverable interoperability
requirements.requirement: Support spreadsheet, notebook and document interchange with audited calculation parity.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No Excel or notebook export.

requirements.section_title: Release strategy, external benchmarks and ecosystem growth
requirements.requirement: Sequence depth before catalogue inflation and add ICB-21..32 with evidence criteria.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Release gates are documented for Phase 9.2.x only.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No external benchmark programme; ICB-21..32 have not been executed.

requirements.section_title: Financial Knowledge Engine: unified, evidence-preserving retrieval
requirements.requirement: Provide retrieval and evidence assembly with historical resolution, factual grounding and explicit abstention.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No retrieval layer; the integration contract is docs/RESEARCH_AND_COMPRESSION_INTEGRATION.md.

requirements.section_title: Compression, CDG and evidence-preserving data research
requirements.requirement: Research representations that reduce total bytes and cost while preserving exact source reconstruction.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None; hypotheses only.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No encoder, corpus or reconstruction test.

requirements.section_title: Intent-to-Research Compiler and adaptive workflows
requirements.requirement: Translate a goal into an editable, typed, permission-aware research plan.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No planner, plan schema or permission checking.

requirements.section_title: Research Integrity Engine: evidence, mathematics and decisions
requirements.requirement: Unify evidence, computational, statistical and decision checks into explicit findings, never a single trust score.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Model Auditor and independent financial audits produce per-check findings.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Statistical-validity and decision-level checks are not part of a unified report.

requirements.section_title: Atlas Resource Optimization Engine: the industrial engineering core
requirements.requirement: Select compute, data, retrieval and storage policies under explicit resource and correctness constraints.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No policy engine or cost model.

requirements.section_title: Data Coverage, Integrity and Service Health Center
requirements.requirement: Report for every displayed number what Atlas can observe, how fresh it is and where the gaps are.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Source status, synthetic labelling, missing-session counts and coverage blocks are surfaced.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No unified coverage, freshness and conflict dashboard; no historical universe reporting.

requirements.section_title: Model Experience System and adaptive human-computer interaction
requirements.requirement: Present one model through synchronized visual, equation, table and code views without separate implementations.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No synchronized multi-view editor.

requirements.section_title: Workflow Portability, Migration and Professional Deliverables
requirements.requirement: Let users import and export professional workflows and artefacts without silent differences.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Application packages are portable; spreadsheets and documents are not.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No spreadsheet, notebook or document import or export.

requirements.section_title: ResearchOS scientific program for AI, RAG, compression and IE
requirements.requirement: Produce academically defensible research with pre-registered, replicated evaluations and published negative results.
requirements.implementation_evidence: None.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No experiment protocol, corpus or replication study.

requirements.section_title: Open-source integration and dependency evaluation registry
requirements.requirement: Maintain a machine-checked registry of candidate integrations with licence, maintenance and security status.
requirements.implementation_evidence: A prose evaluation document exists.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: No machine-readable registry or licence gate.

requirements.section_title: Product delivery sequence and cross-domain user adoption
requirements.requirement: Deliver one complete flagship workflow from company selection through evidence, model, scenarios, export, thesis and monitoring (Section 59.1).
requirements.implementation_evidence: Company, statements, model, scenarios, provenance and saved workspace run end to end; see docs/MASTER_SPEC_V3_IMPLEMENTATION_GAPS.md.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: Narrative evidence retrieval, professional export and monitoring are missing; this is the smallest blocking gap.

requirements.section_title: New Institutional Capability Benchmarks and acceptance matrix
requirements.requirement: Add ICB-33..48 with reproducible fixtures, independent baselines, negative tests and quantitative pass conditions, and publish the Section 60.2 status.
requirements.implementation_evidence: ICB-01..48 registry built with statuses and evidence gaps; no v3 benchmark has been executed.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: ICB-33..48 are specified only.

requirements.section_title: Final platform definition and strategic charter
requirements.requirement: Make research more correct, accessible, reproducible and economical rather than merely adding features.
requirements.implementation_evidence: Charter only.
requirements.unimplemented_dependencies: A judgement criterion, not a testable capability.
